# Word extraction fixture

`legacy-word.doc` is the synthetic Word 97-SR2 test document `test05.doc` from [morungos/node-word-extractor](https://github.com/morungos/node-word-extractor/blob/master/__tests__/data/test05.doc), used to verify actual legacy Word extraction. The upstream [manifest](https://github.com/morungos/node-word-extractor/blob/master/__tests__/data/manifest.md) describes it as a simple test file. Its MIT license is retained in `word-extractor-LICENSE.txt`. It is test data only and is never a production profile or runtime asset.
